pages.title: The ash's own
text: Two of the Wastes' animals live at the edge of lava, one flies through the ash, and one hunts the basalt at night.

Every gentle beast here can be brushed for its reagent once a minute, and is tempted and bred with that same reagent. It can be bonded like any gentle animal (see [familiars](familiars)), though none of them has a familiar gift of its own.

pages.title: Cinderhide
text: A volcanic tortoise, fire showing between the scutes of its shell, that lives beside lava and on the hot stone around it, one or two at a time. **30 health** and **7 armour**, slow, and **immune to fire**.
It drops **1 to 3 Cinder Plates**, an Ember reagent.

pages.title: Ashmoth
text: A grey hawk moth of the ash, swept-winged, its thick body ringed orange-pink, in ones to threes. **10 health**, no armour.
It drops **1 to 3 Ash Wings**, which grind into black dye.

pages.title: Slaglump
text: A fat lava salamander, black with orange blotches, that wallows by lava, one or two at a time. **26 health** and **5 armour**, and **immune to fire**.
It drops **1 to 3 Slag Curd**, an Ember reagent.

pages.title: Emberjaw
text: A striped fire raptor, running low with its tail out behind and mostly jaw, that rises on the basalt at night, one to three at a time. It has **32 health** and **3 armour** and hits for **6**, shoving you back with every blow. For all its colour it is **not** fire-proof.
It drops **1 to 2 Ember Fangs**, a Shove reagent.
